user.title: Set up NZ Parcel Tracker
user.description: Most couriers need no account. DHL tracking needs your own free DHL API key; there is a step-by-step guide at https://github.com/sshadmin147/ha-nz-parcel-tracker/blob/main/docs/dhl-api-key.md. You can skip this now and add the key later from the integration's options.

api_keys.title: DHL API key
api_keys.description: Paste your DHL API key. It is checked with DHL before setup finishes. Guide: https://github.com/sshadmin147/ha-nz-parcel-tracker/blob/main/docs/dhl-api-key.md

abort.already_configured: NZ Parcel Tracker is already set up.

error.invalid_api_key: DHL did not accept that API key. Check you copied the whole key from your app on developer.dhl.com.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DHL to check the key. Try again in a moment.

menu_options.api_keys: Add or change a DHL API key

add_parcel.title: Add a parcel
add_parcel.description: Choose the courier the parcel is with, then enter its tracking number (from the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card). For Post Haste, enter the customer number and the consignment ID separated by a space, for example 2020119 DESX0026044. DHL only appears in the list once you have added a DHL API key.

data_description.tracking_code: Just the number, not a link.

remove_parcels.title: Remove parcels
remove_parcels.description: Select the parcels to stop tracking.

api_keys.title: DHL API key
api_keys.description: Enter a new DHL API key, or leave it blank to keep the current one. Guide: https://github.com/sshadmin147/ha-nz-parcel-tracker/blob/main/docs/dhl-api-key.md

remove_api_keys.title: Remove a DHL API key
remove_api_keys.description: Parcels with that courier stop being tracked until a key is added again.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a tracking number for the chosen courier. Check it is just the number, with letters and numbers only.
error.tracking_code_is_link: That looks like a web address. Enter just the tracking number, not the link.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
error.invalid_api_key: DHL did not accept that API key. Check you copied the whole key from your app on developer.dhl.com.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DHL to check the key. Try again in a moment.
